description: Defines an abstract class OverlayDisplayWindow for managing overlay windows used in remote playback simulation, with implementations for different Android API levels (Legacy and Jellybean MR1). Includes methods for showing, dismissing, updating aspect ratio, and handling user interactions like move and scale.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow
classes.description: Abstract class managing overlay display windows for remote playback simulation, with nested classes for different Android API levels.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow.LegacyImpl
classes.description: Implementation of overlay window for older Android versions using SurfaceView.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow.JellybeanMr1Impl
classes.description: Implementation of overlay window for API 17+ using TextureView, supporting move and scale gestures.

methods.name: OverlayDisplayWindow.create
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate overlay window implementation based on Android version.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Abstract method to display the overlay window.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Abstract method to dismiss the overlay window.

methods.name: updateAspectRatio
methods.description: Abstract method to update the overlay window's aspect ratio.
